caveats: ⚑ ALL values are UNMEASURED kit-text reads. Nothing here is validated against a fight.

⚑ skill1 Environment Setup recurring interval is authored at 10 sec (kit 30 sec, reduced 20 sec by skill2's AS-Formation self-bonus). This ASSUMES AS Formation is applied to self — which the kit presents as a conditional ('Bonus effects when applying AS Formation to self'). If the sim's formation is not AS, the interval is 30 sec AND the whole skill2 second block (True Damage 30.97%, Projectile Explosion 3.09%) is INACTIVE. Both are authored ON; there is no `formation` gate value in the schema for AS/LT, so this is an assumption, not a gate.

⚑ The Environment Setup 10s Damage-Taken debuff + 10s heal are authored as a t=0 passive PLUS a 10s interval trigger, i.e. effectively ~100% uptime under the AS assumption (10s effect on a 10s cycle). If the real interval is 30s, uptime is 1/3 and this over-credits the whole team by ~2.6pp of boss damage-taken for 2/3 of the fight.

⚑ Burst Effect 1 ('Damage taken multiplier … scaled by 100%') is authored as an ADDITIVE second 3.9pp debuff on burst cast. Keyed to burstCast (not fullBurstEnter) because it is this unit's OWN burst block; it is FB-timing-exempt as a burst-cast effect by convention.

⚑ Burst Effect 1 is gated in the kit on 'while in Environment Setup status'. With the interval authored at 10s the status is ~always live, so no gate is authored; under a 30s interval the enhancement would only land on bursts that fall inside a 10s window.
⚑ Damage Taken ▲ is authored as a boss debuff (damageTakenPct) benefiting the WHOLE team, not a self buff.
⚑ 'Battlefield Formation: ATK ▲ 40.07% of the skill user's ATK' is caster-scaled (casterAtkPct → flat ATK add), not the target's own ATK.
⚑ Projectile Explosion Damage ▲ is authored on all allies; it is only consumed by RL kits, so it is inert on non-RL teammates.
⚑ Cadence tuple (MG, 300 ammo, 171 reloadFrames, hitsPerShot 1) is datamined and UNRELIABLE — not authored here (engine-side), flagged for the record.
⚑ noFb is NOT set anywhere (default OFF/FB-by-timing). Measured-only.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Emma: Tactical Upgrade is a Fire/MG/Supporter Burst I whose damage contribution is almost entirely TEAM-FACING: a recurring boss Damage-Taken debuff (Environment Setup), continuous Critical Damage + True Damage + Projectile Explosion team buffs, and a burst-window caster-scaled ATK grant. Self-damage is a plain MG normal attack with no self-scaling lines. Two structural reads drive everything: (1) skill2's 'AS Formation to self' bonus block is authored ACTIVE, which both enables the True Damage 30.97% / Projectile Explosion 3.09% grants and cuts the Environment Setup recurring interval 30s → 10s; (2) with a 10s interval and a 10s effect duration, the Damage-Taken debuff and the heal-over-time run at ~100% uptime, authored as a t=0 passive plus a 10s interval re-trigger. If AS Formation is NOT the sim's assumption, BOTH the second skill2 block and the 10s interval are wrong — that single premise is the largest lever in this file. The heal lines emit recovery EVENTS (ticks:10, 1s interval) with no HP amount, so on-recovery consumers on teammates fire correctly; incoming-healing ▲ and the Exposure taunt are damage-inert and unmodeled. The burst's 'Environment Setup damage taken multiplier scaled by 100%' is authored as an additive second 3.9pp boss debuff for 10s on burst cast.

flags.reasoning: The kit states 'Recurring interval: 30 sec' on skill1 and skill2's AS-Formation self-bonus states 'Recurring interval of Environment Setup ▼ 20 sec continuously'. Authoring the reduced value assumes AS Formation is applied to self. The schema has no formation primitive for AS/LT (the `formation` gate is noB1/hasB1 only), so the assumption is baked in rather than gated. With a 10s effect duration on a 10s interval, Environment Setup runs at ~100% uptime; at 30s it runs at 1/3 uptime and the team loses ~2.6pp of average boss Damage-Taken.
flags.recipe: Record a fight with this unit and read the boss Damage-Taken debuff icon (or a teammate's popup magnitude) at t≈12s and t≈25s. If the debuff is live at both, the interval is 10s; if it is absent at t≈12s and returns near t≈30s, revert to sec:30 AND drop the second skill2 block (True Damage 30.97% / Projectile Explosion 3.09%), since both hinge on the same AS-Formation premise.

flags.reasoning: The `interval` trigger fires first at t=sec, not t=0, but the kit explicitly says the skill activates at the START of battle. A passive block paired with the interval block reproduces t=0 + t=10 + t=20 …; without it the opening 10s would have no debuff and no heal. This is the skill-CD first-fire convention (force-cast-shaped line → first-fire t=0).
flags.recipe: Confirm from footage that the boss carries the Damage-Taken debuff within the first second of the fight. If the first application is instead at t≈10s (or t≈30s), delete the two passive blocks.

flags.reasoning: 'Damage taken multiplier of Environment Setup is scaled by 100%' most plausibly doubles the base 3.9% to 7.8% for the 10s enhancement window. The schema has no primitive to SCALE an existing buff, so the doubling is expressed as a second, independently-applied 3.9pp debuff that coexists with the base one. An alternative reading is that the enhanced value REPLACES the base (net identical here, since 3.9 + 3.9 = 2 × 3.9 only if the engine sums debuff sources — which it does within the damageTaken bucket).
flags.recipe: With a hand-tune fight, compare team popup magnitudes inside vs outside this unit's burst window with no other buffs changing; a ~3.75% lift (7.8/103.9 vs 3.9) confirms the doubling. If the lift is zero, the enhancement is not a damage-taken doubling at all and the block should be deleted.
